name: Caring For Aging Parents
overview: Scripture commands believers to honor and respect their aging parents, promising blessings and long life for those who do so, as seen in Exodus 20:12 and Deuteronomy 5:16. The Old Testament underscores the sacred duty to rise before the elderly and treat them with reverence, linking this respect to the fear of God (Leviticus 19:32). It also sternly warns against cursing parents, equating such actions with severe judgment and spiritual darkness (Leviticus 20:9; Proverbs 20:20), highlighting the seriousness of honoring one's father and mother as a reflection of obedience to the Lord.
